sources.observation: The plaza side has a long open Tuscan colonnade over a dark stone base. Tall arcades at the ends meet the white upper story and its iron balconies.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see linked file for license
sources.observation: Two narrow arched openings flank the clock. The central shallow pediment carries the high flagpole above the tiled roofs.

limitations: The photographed elevations and Terrarium grades guide the story heights and arch proportions. Roof pitches, side windows and ironwork patterns are approximate.
